reviews.comment: Really great guy who cares about his class, only thing is he goes very quick through each lecture but records each to go back and rewatch if you missed anything. Clickers in class are worth a lot of extra credit so make sure to go to class. Gives test correction after each exam and adds 33% of the points missed back to your grade. Semi-hard class.

He's new to teaching but very caring. Office hrs are helpful, he's willing to go over confusing concepts. Homework & prac exams are harder than the actual. Exams are fairly written & he's an easy grader. Class slowly gets harder to don't slack off! Lots of extra credit w clicker so COME TO CLASS! Overall, very solid prof & def would take him again!

It was his first time teaching, lectures were detailed, teaching style was sometimes monotonous. Way of testing is particularly hard, but the extra-credit makes up for it. Willing to explain the concepts over and over again during office hours. Overall, a good professor, interactive class, just has a weird style of asking questions on the exam.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy
